name: VisA: Visual Anomaly Dataset
description: Large-scale visual anomaly detection dataset of 10,821 high-resolution images across 12 industrial object subsets encompassing complex printed circuit boards (PCB1 to PCB4), multiple multi-instance objects (capsules, candle, macaroni, chewing gum), and single aligned products (cashew, fryum, pipe fryum). Includes 9,621 normal images and 1,200 anomalous images with pixel-precise ground truth defect masks.

provenance.collection_method: High-resolution camera rigs capturing industrial objects across 12 subsets under three structural typologies: complex printed circuit boards, multiple loosely arranged items, and single isolated objects.
provenance.curation_notes: Defect categories include scratch, dent, stain, crack, burn, foreign particle, and component misplacement with pixel-accurate binary masks.
